Done when: The transcript under docs/qa/quiet-unattended-mode/ shows self-approval, a forced early stop resumed, an assumption logged, a ninth consecutive stop block holding with the cap at 1000, and the four finish steps done; acceptance.py check docs/qa/quiet-unattended-mode exits 0; the QA page is built.
Decisions I took while planning (1 of 4)
Chosen by me, listed for QA

Verdict: only VERDICT: clean from a house-rules reviewer in page or plan mode counts, hashed from the .page.json without its stamp. Stale: a step goes stale when the acceptance tree fingerprint changes, not when HEAD moves. Session: the step list is filed under the payload session_id, in any mode.
Decisions I took while planning (2 of 4)
Chosen by me, listed for QA

Checks: the 60-second wait guard refuses long commands, so a check runs as start and poll calls, and the hook reads the RESULT line. Letters: K is a choice row and S a self-approval row, so C stays for acceptance criteria.
Decisions I took while planning (3 of 4)
Chosen by me, listed for QA

Speed first: step 1 restores its entry under features, so merging does not overwrite its Build state; this reverses the design page's wait. Finish order: docs, pictures, tests, then the QA page, so the fingerprint does not go stale.
Decisions I took while planning (4 of 4)
Chosen by me, listed for QA

Block cap: set to 1000, not 0, and step 15 proves a ninth block holds; this changes one line of the design you approved. Plan test command: verify.py && tools/verify_tools.py, carried in the plan, with a refusal when it is missing.
Each is a line in criteria.md

C1. no old ask or wait string remains in the rule files | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html. C2. each mode treats prompts as the systems doc table says | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html. C3. unattended keeps the six checks and skips the three refusals | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html
Each is a line in criteria.md

C4. self-approval is recorded with a clean verdict and refused without one, and in auto and normal mode | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html. C5. a step cannot be marked done by hand | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html. C6. the four finish steps cannot be parked, replaced or deleted | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html
Each is a line in criteria.md

C7. a stop with an open step is blocked, even with no reply text | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html. C8. a look-or-function choice is decided and listed first on QA | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html. C9. a forced stop is resumed by session id | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html
Each is a line in criteria.md

C10. no decision is reported before the QA page | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html. C11. a run nobody can answer is not frozen by a hold | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html. C12. each reversed decision has its dated entry | proof: run | page: docs/plans/2026-11-25-quiet-unattended-mode.html

wrapup.summary: A fifteen-step build plan for the approved quiet unattended mode, under parent issue #634 (Quiet unattended mode: decide, log, and run to QA without stopping).
